# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html

{
  "name": "mitt",
  "version": "3.0.1",
  "description": "Tiny 200b functional Event Emitter / pubsub.",
  "module": "dist/mitt.mjs",
  "main": "dist/mitt.js",
  "jsnext:main": "dist/mitt.mjs",
  "umd:main": "dist/mitt.umd.js",
  "source": "src/index.ts",
  "typings": "index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    "types": "./index.d.ts",
    "module": "./dist/mitt.mjs",
    "import": "./dist/mitt.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/mitt.js",
    "default": "./dist/mitt.mjs"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "test": "npm-run-all --silent typecheck lint mocha test-types",

function.name: navigate_symbol
function.description: Find exact definitions or one-hop callees/callers of an identifier. Returns up to six locations; unresolved dynamic calls are explicit. No source evidence: read returned lines with read_code.

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search source/tests; returns at most 3 source units, bounded by bytes. Use English identifiers; match=literal for an exact substring. Empty results: change query. Optional path is exact; path_prefix limits to a directory BEFORE retrieval. Truncated hits include next_line; read remaining relevant lines with read_code.

function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search README/docs/config (not source). Same bounded locations/excerpts as search_code. Use English keywords; path/path_prefix filter BEFORE retrieval; empty results do not prove absence.

function.name: read_code
function.description: Read exact source or documentation lines from the snapshot. Supply path, start_line, end_line. Optional expand=symbol includes the enclosing function/class/test. At most 100 lines, bounded bytes; next_line means more remains. Only shown lines can be cited.

function.name: trace_dependencies
function.description: Resolve static local imports of one source path. Returns related paths, not a runtime call graph. External/dynamic imports may be unresolved; read returned paths before making claims.

function.name: find_tests
function.description: Find candidate tests for a source path, optionally with a symbol query. Returns short excerpts; read relevant test ranges to verify assertions. A match does not prove executed coverage.

function.description: Find exact definitions or one-hop callees/callers of an identifier. Returns up to six locations; unresolved dynamic calls are explicit. No source evidence: read returned lines with read_code.

function.name: search_code

function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search README/docs/config (not source). Same bounded locations/excerpts as search_code. Use English keywords; path/path_prefix filter BEFORE retrieval; empty results do not prove absence.

function.name: read_code
function.description: Read exact source or documentation lines from the snapshot. Supply path, start_line, end_line. Optional expand=symbol includes the enclosing function/class/test. At most 100 lines, bounded bytes; next_line means more remains. Only shown lines can be cited.

function.name: trace_dependencies
function.description: Resolve static local imports of one source path. Returns related paths, not a runtime call graph. External/dynamic imports may be unresolved; read returned paths before making claims.

function.name: find_tests
function.description: Find candidate tests for a source path, optionally with a symbol query. Returns short excerpts; read relevant test ranges to verify assertions. A match does not prove executed coverage.

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). # Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html

answer.architectureOverview: Mitt 是一个基于 TypeScript 泛型的轻量级事件发射器。核心逻辑在 `src/index.ts` 中，通过 `EventHandlerMap` 类型定义事件类型与处理器的映射关系。`mitt` 函数实例化此映射，`on`/`off` 方法修改映射内容，`emit` 方法遍历映射执行回调。测试位于 `test/index_test.ts`，验证事件触发、类型匹配及通配符行为。

readingPath.why: 理解核心类型定义（`Emitter`, `EventHandlerMap`）与 `mitt` 函数逻辑。
验证 `emit` 如何触发 `on` 注册的处理器，以及通配符 `*` 的处理机制。
确认构建工具链（`microbundle`）与测试命令，了解项目依赖与输出格式。

keyPatterns.description: 使用 TypeScript 泛型将事件类型与处理器列表强绑定，确保类型安全。
允许注册 `*` 事件处理器，`emit` 时遍历所有匹配事件类型或通配符的处理器。
无运行时依赖，依赖 TypeScript 编译，构建为 ES/CJS/UMD 多格式。

function.name: navigate_symbol
function.description: Find exact definitions or one-hop callees/callers of an identifier. Returns up to six locations; unresolved dynamic calls are explicit. No source evidence: read returned lines with read_code.

function.name: search_code
function.description: Search source/tests; returns at most 3 source units, bounded by bytes. Use English identifiers; match=literal for an exact substring. Empty results: change query. Optional path is exact; path_prefix limits to a directory BEFORE retrieval. Truncated hits include next_line; read remaining relevant lines with read_code.

function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search README/docs/config (not source). Same bounded locations/excerpts as search_code. Use English keywords; path/path_prefix filter BEFORE retrieval; empty results do not prove absence.

function.name: read_code
function.description: Read exact source or documentation lines from the snapshot. Supply path, start_line, end_line. Optional expand=symbol includes the enclosing function/class/test. At most 100 lines, bounded bytes; next_line means more remains. Only shown lines can be cited.

function.name: trace_dependencies
function.description: Resolve static local imports of one source path. Returns related paths, not a runtime call graph. External/dynamic imports may be unresolved; read returned paths before making claims.

function.name: find_tests
function.description: Find candidate tests for a source path, optionally with a symbol query. Returns short excerpts; read relevant test ranges to verify assertions. A match does not prove executed coverage.

基于已核验的源码（`src/index.ts` 类型定义部分）和文档，以下是关于 **mitt** 核心实现、静态依赖与架构的解读，以及推荐的阅读路径。

### 1. 核心实现 (Core Implementation)
*   **架构本质**：mitt 目前仅是一个**类型定义层**（Type-only library）。在 `src/index.ts` 中，`Emitter` 接口和 `mitt` 函数仅包含 TypeScript 类型声明（泛型约束、接口方法签名），**没有实际的运行时逻辑代码**（如 `Map` 操作、事件分发逻辑）。
*   **类型系统**：
    *   它使用泛型 `Events extends Record<EventType, unknown>` 来定义事件结构。
    *   支持两种处理器：`Handler<T>`（接收特定事件类型）和 `WildcardHandler<T>`（接收任意事件类型）。
    *   通过 `EventHandlerMap` 映射事件类型到处理器列表。
*   **运行时行为**：实际的“发射”、“监听”、“取消监听”逻辑被剥离到了构建步骤。根据 `package.json` 的构建脚本，这些逻辑由 **microbundle** 在构建时注入（通常通过 `microbundle` 的 `inject` 选项或类似机制将运行时代码合并到输出中），或者在 `dist` 目录中由其他文件（如 `runtime.js` 或内联代码）提供。源码中未包含运行时实现。

### 2. 静态依赖 (Static Dependencies)
*   **直接依赖**：源码 `src/index.ts` 中**没有**任何 `import` 语句，因此没有静态运行时依赖。
*   **构建依赖**：
    *   `microbundle`：用于将 TypeScript 编译并注入运行时逻辑，生成多格式（ES, CJS, UMD）输出。
    *   `tsconfig.json`（未读取，但推断存在）：用于 TypeScript 类型检查。
    *   `mocha`, `sinon`, `chai`：用于测试（见 `package.json` 脚本）。
*   **导出结构**：通过 `exports` 字段导出 `types`、`module`、`import`、`require` 和 `default`，支持 ES 模块和 CommonJS 两种消费方式。

### 3. 架构特点
*   **零依赖运行时**：核心源码本身不依赖任何外部库，旨在保持极小的包体积（约 200 字节压缩）。
*   **类型驱动**：架构完全由 TypeScript 泛型驱动，确保类型安全。
*   **构建时注入**：运行时行为（事件注册、分发）不在源码中，而是在构建过程中由工具注入。

### 4. 阅读路径 (Reading Path)

#### 第一步：入口文件 (Entry Point)
*   **文件**：`src/index.ts`
*   **内容**：仅包含类型定义（L1-L40）。
*   **目的**：理解 `Emitter` 接口和 `mitt` 函数的类型签名，确认其泛型约束和事件处理器的定义。

#### 第二步：构建与依赖 (Build & Dependencies)
*   **文件**：`package.json`
*   **内容**：构建脚本（`microbundle`）、导出配置（`exports`）、依赖声明。
*   **目的**：理解运行时逻辑是如何被注入的，以及项目如何被构建为不同格式。

#### 第三步：测试验证 (Test Verification)
*   **文件**：`test/index_test.ts`
*   **内容**：
    *   L1-6: 导入和依赖声明。
    *   L163-204: 具体的行为测试（如事件触发、大小写敏感性、通配符 `*` 处理）。
*   **目的**：验证 `mitt` 在注入运行时逻辑后的实际行为。由于源码中无实现，测试是验证构建产物正确性的唯一依据。

### 总结
mitt 是一个**类型优先**的库。源码 `src/index.ts` 定义了“应该是什么”，而 `microbundle` 构建过程负责实现“实际是什么”。阅读时应先理解类型接口，再查看构建配置以了解运行时逻辑的注入方式，最后通过测试确认行为。

## Install

This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed.

```sh
$ npm install --save mitt
```

Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else:

```javascript
// using ES6 modules
import mitt from 'mitt'

// using CommonJS modules
var mitt = require('mitt')
```

The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com):

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/mitt/dist/mitt.umd.js"></script>
```

You can find the library on `window.mitt`.

根据项目文档和配置，以下是关于 Mitt 库的安装、开发、测试方式及入门建议：

### 1. 安装方式
*   **npm 安装**：项目依赖 Node.js 和 npm，通过 `npm install --save mitt` 安装。
*   **模块引入**：
    *   **ES6 模块**：`import mitt from 'mitt'`
    *   **CommonJS**：`var mitt = require('mitt')`
*   **UMD 构建**：支持在浏览器中通过 `<script src="https://unpkg.com/mitt/dist/mitt.umd.js"></script>` 引入，挂载到 `window.mitt`。
*   **构建工具**：推荐使用 rollup 或 webpack 等模块打包工具进行集成。

### 2. 开发方式
*   **源码位置**：核心实现位于 `src/index.ts`。
*   **类型定义**：提供 `index.d.ts` 作为 TypeScript 类型声明。
*   **构建命令**：
    *   **打包**：`npm run bundle` (使用 microbundle 生成 es, cjs, umd 格式)。
    *   **完整构建**：`npm run build` (清理、打包、生成文档)。
*   **依赖环境**：开发环境基于 TypeScript 和 Node.js，无运行时外部依赖。

### 3. 测试方式
*   **运行测试**：`npm test` (默认运行 mocha 和类型检查)。
*   **具体命令**：
    *   `npm run mocha`：运行 mocha 测试（支持 `.ts` 文件）。
    *   `npm run test-types`：运行 TypeScript 类型编译检查 (`tsc`)。
    *   `npm run lint`：运行 ESLint 检查。
*   **测试文件**：主要测试位于 `test/index_test.ts`，验证事件触发、类型匹配及通配符行为。

### 4. 入门建议
*   **核心特性**：Mitt 是一个轻量级（压缩后小于 200 字节）、无依赖的事件发射器/发布订阅系统，支持 IE9+。
*   **设计模式**：采用纯函数式设计，方法不依赖 `this`，支持泛型类型系统以提供类型安全的处理器映射。
*   **特殊功能**：支持通配符事件 `"*"` 来监听所有事件。
*   **文档更新**：API 文档由 `documentation` 工具自动生成，建议通过更新源码来维护文档。

**缺口说明**：
*   未读取 `.github` 目录下的具体 CI 配置细节（如具体分支策略）。
*   未读取 `src/index.ts` 的具体实现逻辑（仅知接口定义）。

根据项目文档和配置，以下是关于 Mitt 库的安装、开发、测试方式及入门建议：

### 1. 安装方式
*   **npm 安装**：项目依赖 Node.js 和 npm，通过 `npm install --save mitt` 安装。
*   **模块引入**：
    *   **ES6 模块**：`import mitt from 'mitt'`
    *   **CommonJS**：`var mitt = require('mitt')`
*   **UMD 构建**：支持在浏览器中通过 `<script src="https://unpkg.com/mitt/dist/mitt.umd.js"></script>` 引入，挂载到 `window.mitt`。
*   **构建工具**：推荐使用 rollup 或 webpack 等模块打包工具进行集成。

### 2. 开发方式
*   **源码位置**：核心实现位于 `src/index.ts`。
*   **类型定义**：提供 `index.d.ts` 作为 TypeScript 类型声明。
*   **构建命令**：
    *   **打包**：`npm run bundle` (使用 microbundle 生成 es, cjs, umd 格式)。
    *   **完整构建**：`npm run build` (清理、打包、生成文档)。
*   **依赖环境**：开发环境基于 TypeScript 和 Node.js，无运行时外部依赖。

### 3. 测试方式
*   **运行测试**：`npm test` (默认运行 mocha 和类型检查)。
*   **具体命令**：
    *   `npm run mocha`：运行 mocha 测试（支持 `.ts` 文件）。
    *   `npm run test-types`：运行 TypeScript 类型编译检查 (`tsc`)。
    *   `npm run lint`：运行 ESLint 检查。
*   **测试文件**：主要测试位于 `test/index_test.ts`，验证事件触发、类型匹配及通配符行为。

### 4. 入门建议
*   **核心特性**：Mitt 是一个轻量级（压缩后小于 200 字节）、无依赖的事件发射器/发布订阅系统，支持 IE9+。
*   **设计模式**：采用纯函数式设计，方法不依赖 `this`，支持泛型类型系统以提供类型安全的处理器映射。
*   **特殊功能**：支持通配符事件 `"*"` 来监听所有事件。
*   **文档更新**：API 文档由 `documentation` 工具自动生成，建议通过更新源码来维护文档。

**缺口说明**：
*   未读取 `.github` 目录下的具体 CI 配置细节（如具体分支策略）。

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "**"
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: 14
      - name: npm install, build, and test
        run: |
          npm install
          npm run build --if-present
          npm test
        env:
          CI: true

### Reporting Issues

Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues).
If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new).

## Contribute

First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute!
Now, take a moment to be sure your contributions make sense to everyone else.

### Submitting pull requests

Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits.

-   Fork it!
-   Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/mitt`
-   Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt`
-   Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature`
-   Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`
-   Make your changes.
-   Commit your changes: `git commit -am 'Add some feature'`
-   Push to the branch: `git push origin my-new-feature`
-   Submit a pull request with full remarks documenting your changes.
